newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Wet Seal raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Wet Seal raised.

text.p: -- Schroder Wertheim said on Thursday it had raised its rating for women's apparel retailer Wet Seal Inc to outperform from perform in line.
-- "The recent pullback in share price has provided an attractive entry point," analyst Richard Jaffe wrote in a report.
-- "We believe that the Wet Seal story remains compelling as the turnaround and growth of the Wet Seal/Contempo Casual business has outpaced expectations."
-- He added, "We believe that the fundamentals remain sound and we anticipate earnings growth of 20 percent in 1997, driven by six percent comparable store sales ..."
